name: com.jiahaoli.weft
description: Weft pages (HTML-like scenes with CSS, React and D3) as game UI: the weft runtime as a native plugin, drawn on Unity's render thread with Direct3D 11, Direct3D 12 or Vulkan (Windows x64).

samples.description: A full-screen page to try by hand: hover, press and click, a call to Unity, wheel zoom of a url() image, pointer coordinates, a view model, and a label anchored to a turning cube. Weft > 打开演示 opens it.
